data.content_ref: inline:The 'Reliability-Compliance Paradox' integrates SRC_001 and SRC_004 by proposing that the very mechanism that increases reliability (low-variance additive process) simultaneously increases the risk of 'blind compliance' (treating the checklist as a ritual). It is refuted if the rate of 'lapse errors' decreases without a corresponding increase in 'compliance-driven' false positives when the checklist is expanded.
